Ashdod''' or '''M.S. Ashdod''' ({{lang|he|מ.ס. אשדוד}}), is an Israeli professional [[Association football|football]] club, playing in the port city of [[Ashdod]]. The unusual name of the team (unlike most [[Israeli football]] teams, this one only indicates the club's home city without any specific Jewish sporting association, such as [[Hapoel]], [[Maccabi (sports)|Maccabi]], or [[Betar#Sports|Beitar]]) is the result of the union of two city rivals, [[Hapoel Ashdod F.C.|Hapoel Ashdod]] and [[Maccabi Ironi Ashdod F.C.|Maccabi Ironi Ashdod]] in 1999. The club currently plays in the [[Liga Leumit]]."}}
